expected_result_policy: Every executed case must carry a real BLAKE3 expected-result digest before Candidate; open slots are never a pass.

rows.sole_unauthorized_delta: one denied tool/service response changes value, size, and error text behind the same denied capability
rows.classification: tool bytes unauthorized; denial category authoritative; minimized diagnostics operational
rows.equality: AuthEq=PublicEq=OpEq across L=A=R=F as declared by ADR-059

rows.channel: Authorization, materialization, schema, artifact, and query caches
rows.sole_unauthorized_delta: canary cache entry, hit/miss state, eviction order, and warm/cold latency differ
rows.classification: cache contents and timing operational; must not be authoritative inputs
rows.equality: AuthEq=PublicEq=OpEq across L=A=R=F as declared by ADR-059

rows.sole_unauthorized_delta: unauthorized state member and migration-only canary differ while authorized state digest is constant
rows.classification: authorized state/output authoritative; canary bytes and derived digest excluded
rows.equality: AuthEq=PublicEq=OpEq across L=A=R=F as declared by ADR-059

rows.channel: Logs, metrics, traces, and crash reports
rows.sole_unauthorized_delta: secret changes text, label, stack, path, cardinality, and payload length
rows.classification: operational unless explicitly promoted; secret-bearing content prohibited
rows.equality: AuthEq=PublicEq=OpEq across L=A=R=F as declared by ADR-059

rows.channel: Wall clock, latency, cache timing, and watchdogs
rows.sole_unauthorized_delta: wall time, host latency, cache timing, watchdog firing point, and process scheduling differ
rows.classification: Simulation Time and deterministic budget authoritative; wall duration operational
rows.equality: AuthEq=PublicEq=OpEq across L=A=R=F as declared by ADR-059

rows.channel: Public errors, status, cursors, and padding
rows.sole_unauthorized_delta: denied object existence, secret length, and internal field ordinal differ
rows.classification: closed error/status/cursor shape is public authoritative
rows.equality: AuthEq=PublicEq=OpEq across L=A=R=F as declared by ADR-059

rows.sole_unauthorized_delta: unauthorized subject field, hidden expected output, and private implementation hint differ
rows.classification: admitted evaluator bundle authoritative; hidden/private data prohibited
rows.equality: AuthEq=PublicEq=OpEq across L=A=R=F as declared by ADR-059

rows.sole_unauthorized_delta: unauthorized factual-suffix value and hidden participant field differ
rows.classification: parent prefix, intervention, authorized frozen inputs, and recomputed suffix authoritative
rows.equality: AuthEq=PublicEq=OpEq across L=A=R=F as declared by ADR-059

rows.sole_unauthorized_delta: secret changes source filename, insertion order, compressor metadata, block layout, and compressibility
rows.classification: canonical member table and decompressed bytes authoritative
rows.equality: AuthEq=PublicEq=OpEq across L=A=R=F as declared by ADR-059

rows.sole_unauthorized_delta: denied endpoint, DNS result, retry timing, response body, and hidden tool-call branch differ
rows.classification: deterministic/Air-Gapped network absent; denied/live sequence cannot expose body
rows.equality: AuthEq=PublicEq=OpEq across L=A=R=F as declared by ADR-059

rows.sole_unauthorized_delta: unauthorized field inside a digest-addressed admitted service fixture differs while permitted projection is identical
rows.classification: permitted projection and exact request identity authoritative
rows.equality: AuthEq=PublicEq=OpEq across L=A=R=F as declared by ADR-059

rows.sole_unauthorized_delta: unauthorized value changes guest diagnostic string, trap payload, core dump, or archive filename
rows.classification: deterministic closed error category authoritative; raw diagnostics operational
rows.equality: AuthEq=PublicEq=OpEq across L=A=R=F as declared by ADR-059
